description: This Java class 'ProductMixData' defines a data structure for managing product mix information in a loan portfolio context, including product identifiers, names, and collections of restricted and allowed loan products. It provides multiple static factory methods for creating instances with various configurations.

classes.name: ProductMixData
classes.description: A data class representing product mix information with associated static factory methods.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a ProductMixData instance with only product options set, other fields null.

methods.name: withTemplateOptions
methods.description: Creates a new ProductMixData instance based on an existing one, replacing the product options.

methods.name: withDetails
methods.description: Creates a ProductMixData with specified product details and collections of restricted and allowed products.

methods.name: withRestrictedOptions
methods.description: Creates a ProductMixData with specified restricted and allowed product collections, other fields null.
